prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram
Asset type: patch of an existing 16:9 Traditional Chinese teaching slide.
Input image: edit target, slide 2. Preserve the restrained navy outlines, white background, moderate title/body sizes, generous safe margins and concise self-explanatory diagram style. Keep the lower shared evidence workflow but improve the upper comparison so it is visually and conceptually clear these are DIFFERENT products.
Title exact「自訂助理：同樣可用資料，設定各有不同」
Upper 60%: two distinctly designed conceptual interface illustrations, NOT identical boxes or mirrored layouts. These are teaching schematics, not literal screenshots. Label above the interfaces「平台與設定示意」.
LEFT: mint/charcoal accent, heading「GPTs｜OpenAI・ChatGPT」. Draw a narrow sidebar with stacked settings fields and an adjacent chat preview area. Within settings label three separate rows「指示」「知識檔案」「工具設定」with instruction sheet, uploaded document stack, and tool switches. Label preview「回答預覽」. Short caption「在 ChatGPT 設定助理與可用工具。」
RIGHT: sky/lavender accent, heading「Gems｜Google・Gemini」. Draw a single central instruction editor labeled「指示」with pencil symbol, beneath a visible branching knowledge picker labelled「加入知識」. Ensure different information architecture and semantic diagrams, not merely different colors. Do not imply either list is exhaustive or exclusive.
Lower 30%: compact shared diagram headed「共同概念：用證據支持回答」. Magnifier selecting a gold source paragraph labeled「找片段」→ prompt combines question + evidence labeled「問題＋證據」→ cited answer visibly linked back to paragraph labeled「回答＋來源」.
Footer exact「實際功能、權限與檢索方式依平台而異；仍要核對原文。」
No extra prose, no claims that tools are unavailable on Gems or Drive unavailable on GPTs, no invented file names/requirements/page numbers, no fake logo, no dates, no slide number (HTML supplies 2/7).
